data.notice: All measurements in this file are synthetic report examples.

findings.title: Sustained high CPU activity
findings.evidence: CPU utilization was 95.0–95.0% across 15 contiguous observations over 14.0 seconds; configured threshold 90%.
findings.explanation: Sustained CPU demand can delay other applications. Utilization alone does not prove overheating or throttling.
possible_causes: An application is performing intensive work
findings.next_step: Inspect the highest CPU-consuming processes and determine whether their work is expected before requesting termination.

findings.title: A mounted volume is nearly full
findings.evidence: Volume [redacted] uses 98.0% of 100.0 GiB; 2.00 GiB remains.
findings.explanation: Low filesystem space can prevent updates and application writes. This measures the mounted filesystem, not physical drive health.
findings.next_step: Review storage usage and move or remove only files you recognize after backing up important data.

interpretation: Read-only observations and rule-based findings; unavailable metrics are not zero. SMART results cannot guarantee future drive reliability. No universal health score is used.
